about: Modwerk source-only filter-hz package for Analog Rytm MKII OS 1.74, compiled from sdk/analog-rytm-mkii/modules/filter-hz.

mods.title: Filter Hz
mods.summary: The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.
mods.description: The FILTER page's FRQ popup shows the cutoff in hertz, from 13.8Hz to 21.1kHz, instead of 0 to 127.
mods.author: Iced-Cream
mods.on_unit: Tested on an Analog Rytm MKII on OS 1.74 with the released core-ar2 0.3 (FZ78, RAM boot, 2026-11-14, reported by npp1993); 1.2.0 as FZ74.
